test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Machinist) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT about end standard?

options.text: It is used to measure the distance between two engraved lines.
It measures the distance between two parallel flat surfaces.
It is slower but more accurate.

solution:
The correct answer is __It is used to measure the distance between two engraved lines.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• End standards__ are used for precise measurement of lengths.
 
• They measure the distance between two parallel flat surfaces of the standard.
 
• End standards are highly accurate but require more time for measurement compared to line standards.
 
• The faces of end standards are subject to wear and must be handled carefully.
 
• Line standards, in contrast, measure the distance between two engraved lines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Line Standards:**

 
 
• Line standards refer to measurements based on the distance between two engraved lines.
 
• They are faster to use but less accurate compared to end standards.
 
 
 
• **End Standards:**
 
 
• End standards are used for precise length measurements by measuring the distance between two flat surfaces.
 
• Examples include slip gauges and gauge blocks.
